description.en: A masterfully frosted piece designed to balance out the cold metal of your keys. It’s just a simple pop of sweetness for your daily setup that stays pristine no matter where you toss it. No melting, no mess — a tiny, flawless treat for your pockets. Pure eye candy. Zero calories.
